faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What people ask before signing up.

broker.a: No. Doni does not buy or sell securities. You keep placing orders with your SGI and record your trades in Doni to track them.

advice.a: No. Doni provides information and education only. Decisions to buy or sell are yours.

live.a: No. Doni shows end-of-day prices from the BRVM's official daily bulletin, always with their date. If a day's data fails our checks, Doni keeps showing the last verified day until it has been reviewed.

privacy.a: Only you. You can export all your data or delete your account at any time.

countries.a: The BRVM is the shared stock exchange of the eight UEMOA countries: Benin, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Guinea-Bissau, Mali, Niger, Senegal and Togo. Doni is available in French and English.
